(2) doctor: new sandbox-config-lock category; safe heal re-checks the predicate.
(3) tests: tempdir repos cover placeholder removed then success, recreated placeholder cleared and retried once, non-empty or 0644 lock left alone with git's error surfaced, doctor scan and heal.
